summary: Executed backend regression + targeted standalone/cover tests and deep mobile UI validation on preview URL with seeded QA data. Most P0/P1 checks passed, with one reproducible mobile navigation regression after closing BookForm drawer.

minor.issue: 202 timing path (~1.25s) was not deterministically reproduced in this run; existing behavior is code-reviewed and prior tests pass for saved cover 200/ETag and first-available parallel race unit test.

action_items: Fix tab-bar interaction race after BookForm drawer close (likely overlay/pointer-event/timing issue).
Re-validate /api/covers first uncached request 202 timing path with deterministic slow source harness if required by release criteria.
After fix, rerun mobile sequence: open drawer -> close -> tap calendar/stats/library tabs repeatedly.
critical_code_review_comments: Viewport/full-height stack is correctly implemented: body relative (not fixed), #root is scroller, #app-overlay mirrors app height; measured unused bottom strip was 0px across tested sizes.
PageHeader behavior is stable: title stays 22px, row stays 44px, subtitle correctly scrolls under opaque header, and no blur/backdrop bleed observed.

Standalone grouping logic in backend matches requested semantics in tested cases: finished no-series and manual 'Lonely Books' included; genuine series, non-finished, and 'Band 2' title marker cases excluded.
seed_data_creation: Created preview QA seed set (marker TEST_UI3_f93053, 29 books incl. one uploaded JPEG fixture with current-month reading dates) via /app/tests/ui_seed_iteration3.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use seeded marker TEST_UI3_f93053 for quick calendar/author cover checks. Verified calendar week and month-list cover images load as blob with naturalWidth>0 once intersected/scrolled into view; authors mini-covers also blob-backed. Repro for high bug: mobile 390x844 -> Library -> open add-book drawer -> close -> tap tab-calendar: path may remain '/'.
rca of the issue: TabBar regression RCA (frontend): reproducible state-dependent interaction issue. Steps: login -> library -> click add-book-button -> close form -> click tab-calendar. Expected route '/calendar'; actual route stays '/'. Baseline tab click without drawer works, suggesting a post-drawer interaction race (overlay teardown, focus trap, or transient pointer-event interception).
